claude.sample_unit: numeric candidates extracted from laboratory PDF reports

links.outcome: Share of LLM-extracted lab candidates admitted by schema, packet-level, and quotation/row-level automated checks
links.effect: Of 97 numeric candidates, schema validation accepted 97, the earlier packet-level check accepted 94, and the hardened policy admitted 72 and retained 25 for review. Correctness of the admitted candidates was not evaluated.
links.quote: The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review.

unlisted_practices: Evidence-gated trust promotion that keeps generated data provisional until a deterministic monitor verifies it against the source document
Preventing the generator from approving its own output and refusing on missing or ambiguous evidence
Preserving provenance and retaining refused candidates for human review
Conformance and mutation testing of the verification monitor
